args.command: export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG="nothingness_linux_debug"; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG="/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log"; for i in {1..30}; do if grep -q "Launching lib/main.dart on Linux" "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" 2>/dev/null; then echo "booting"; fi; if grep -q "Dart VM service" "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" 2>/dev/null; then echo "vm ready"; break; fi; sleep 1; done; tail -n 20 "$DRIVE_RUN_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true
